title: A Little Butterfly
style: Ambient dubstep with candy-bright melodic lead, deep rounded sub-bass, delicate triangles and xylophone; close-mic female vocals with an almost-childish, mellow melodic delivery; unhurried, gently pulsing groove; wide reverb tails.
lyrics:
A little butterfly
sings on her leaf, waiting
for a mate to appear
while remembering her past.

She was a little caterpillar
whose dream was to eat,
to eat and eat and eat,
and grow bigger at every turn.

A little butterfly
sings on her leaf, remembering
when life was much simpler,
following her siblings and eating.

She was a little caterpillar
who thought nothing of growing up,
until a day she decided to rest
and silked herself around.

A little butterfly
sings on her leaf, forgetting
the growing pains of becoming
the butterfly she is now.

She was a little caterpillar
with only one thing on her mind;
now she is a butterfly
with many cravings and many lights.
